project_info.color_palette: Aqua blue, white, leaf green, soft floral pink, clean sky blue

main_subject.detail: A centered Surf excel Easy Wash detergent pouch on a pale blue reflective base, its top opening erupting into a white powder cloud with water droplets, fabric wisps, leaves, and flower petals.
main_subject.style: Premium FMCG product-explosion advertisement with clean freshness

items: Bottom center: upright blue detergent pouch with logo and Easy Wash product text.
Upper center: high frozen plume of white powder, foam fragments, and blue droplets.
Within plume: translucent white fabric, green leaves, and small pink flowers.
Background: airy blue studio gradient fading pale near the base.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Ultra-sharp frozen particles, bright soft blue backlight, clear packaging, delicate shadow at base

assets.name: Surf excel Easy Wash pouch
assets.usage: Keep pouch silhouette, logo, graphics, colors, and wording authentic.

prompt_instructions: Attach the exact detergent pouch reference.
Do not obscure the branding with the explosion.
Use freshness props only as physically light suspended particles.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra - realistic commercial FMCG photography showing a BRAND_NAME PRODUCT_TYPE revealed or opened at the bottom center of the frame. The product bursts upward in frozen mid - air motion. Dynamic splashes, pours, fragments, or particles related to VARIANT explode around it. Fresh KEY_INGREDIENT elements appear whole and cut, suspended naturally with fine particles. The BRAND_NAME logo and “VARIANT” text are clearly readable on realistic packaging with authentic material texture. Gradient background inspired by the variant. Dramatic studio lighting. Ultra - sharp focus. Premium cinematic advertising realism. 8K quality. 3:4 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: altered package, incorrect Surf excel logo, unreadable variant text, heavy dark shadows, muddy powder, weak burst, low resolution, watermark
